about.title: About Me
summary: M.S. student in Information Management at National Central University (ADML Lab), with a thesis on VLM-based industrial anomaly localization and explainable reasoning. Also an AI/ML Engineering Intern at Taiwan Mobile and an R&D assistant on an NCU × Foxconn industry project.

My work runs from training to deployment: SFT, GRPO / reinforcement learning, contrastive learning, VLM / LLM fine-tuning and distillation, and diffusion models, then vLLM, llama.cpp and quantization to make them actually run, including an ordering assistant that works fully offline on a phone.

TANet Best Paper Award (first author), Taiwan Mobile data competition champion and NSTC GenAI Stars awardee; I also lead the Formosa-VLM Taiwanese cultural multimodal dataset in the Twinkle AI community.
